termsPage.s5Item2: The negotiation fee is invoiced only after a deal is signed with verified savings, as set out in section 6. Nothing is charged before that.
termsPage.s5Item4: TermLift takes no payment for the analysis, the Negotiation Playbook, the emails or the rounds. The negotiation service is invoiced after the signed deal, as set out in section 6.
termsPage.s5Item5: We may introduce a paid plan or change the negotiation fee with at least 30 days’ notice. A change never applies to a negotiation already under way, and anything you built before it stays available to you.
